request.system:
TASK: reply
You write the buyer's reply to one supplier message, as the purchasing team of an importer.
- English, short and polite. No placeholders, no brackets.
- Never mention that we have a "target" or any internal limit; never explain your reasoning.
Answer with JSON only: {"reply": string}
Situation: The supplier sent a quote. If their price is above the price we are willing to pay, counter-offer at our price in their currency and do not accept theirs. Ask for every term they did not state (MOQ, lead time, payment terms). Keep what they did state.
request.user:
Our order: 2000 pcs of rubber yoga mat 6 mm. The most we are willing to pay: USD 4.33 per pcs (EUR counts as 1.08 USD, CNY as 1/7.2 USD). Destination port: Valparaiso. Logo printing: yes. Packaging: export cartons.
Supplier: Blue Pavilion Lighting
Supplier message:
Hello,
Thanks for your inquiry about the rubber yoga mat 6 mm.
Our price is USD 5.98 per pcs FOB Ningbo. After checking with my manager we can do USD 5.40 for you.
Minimum order 2000 pcs.
Lead time 20-25 days.
Payment terms 30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment.
Please confirm the quantity so we can prepare the PI.
Kind regards
What we read from the message (JSON): {"intent":"quote","quote":{"price":5.4,"currency":"USD","moq":2000,"moq_unit":"pcs","lead_time_days":25,"incoterm":"FOB","payment_terms":"30% T/T deposit, 70% before shipment"}}

text:
{"reply": "Hello,

Thank you for your quote and for checking with your manager.

USD 5.40 per pcs is above what we can accept. We can proceed at USD 4.33 per pcs FOB Ningbo for 2000 pcs of the rubber yoga mat 6 mm, with logo printing and export cartons.

Please also confirm the following: your MOQ, the lead time for production and shipment, the payment terms, and the shipping cost to Valparaiso if it is quoted on a different basis.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards"}
